family_decision: Which public plan owns each dated nightly sample in the room comparison? A low anonymous amount is not the same cancellation or meal choice as a flexible rate.
hypothesis: Grouped nightly numbers without plan labels are sufficient for the overview budget decision.
before: Current approved Boston comparison groups Park Plaza USD 372.10 / 444.84 / 528.68 without their plan names; parent must move to detailed tables to distinguish the non-refundable, flexible and breakfast choices. This is a page-only proxy observation, not human testing.
result: REJECT sufficiency; IMPLEMENT labels from the same validated public price records beside every nightly amount, retaining all plans rather than a lowest-price ranking.
limits: No new price inspection, live offer, final all-fee budget, exact Park Plaza age acceptance, cancellation guarantee, cheapest/suitable hotel or price-only booking recommendation. The USD 500 ceiling is hypothetical; tax/fee and meals differ, extra bedding and actual setup remain unknown.
confidence: High in maintained plan/amount identity and the visible ambiguity; unknown actual parent satisfaction or SEO impact.
lesson: Keep plan identity beside price when comparing rooms; do not strip cancellation and inclusion choices into an anonymous amount band.
next_falsification_trigger: Plan/amount record drift or a failed overview task; original Park Plaza price review October 15, Fenway October 17. No automatic renewal.
